units.source_text: [\[21\]](#part1330.html#w21) 宫中巡夜，亥时（十点钟）起由左近卫官值班，丑时（两点钟）起由右近卫官值班。

en.t: For palace night patrols, officials of the Left Palace Guards went on duty from the hour of the Boar (ten o'clock), and officials of the Right Palace Guards from the hour of the Ox (two o'clock).
While on duty, each called out his own name.
